## Manuscript numbers

Every statistic quoted in the manuscript is computed here and written to a single
file, so that the text and the pipeline cannot drift apart between revisions.

```{r}
curated_sources_final <- c("PhosphoSitePlus", "EPSD", "iPTMNet")
# combined_pairs is re-read and relabelled upstream, so atlas rows carry the
# label "Specificity Atlas" rather than "Cantley" by the time we get here.
atlas_source_label <- if ("Specificity Atlas" %in% combined_pairs$Source)
  "Specificity Atlas" else "Cantley"

pairs_curated <- combined_pairs %>%
  filter(Source %in% curated_sources_final) %>%
  distinct(Kinase, Substrate)
pairs_atlas <- combined_pairs %>%
  filter(Source == atlas_source_label) %>%
  distinct(Kinase, Substrate)
pairs_novel <- anti_join(pairs_atlas, pairs_curated, by = c("Kinase", "Substrate"))

novel_per_kinase <- pairs_novel %>% count(Kinase, name = "n_novel")

# Matches the definition plotted in Figure 2B: one row per unique motif-passing
# site, "pass" = curated OR functional-score support. `pct_func_only`
# is the functional-score-only figure, restricted to sites that actually carry a
# score, which is the quantity the running text refers to.
residue_pass <- cantley_sites90 %>%
  mutate(residue = substr(Site, 1, 1)) %>%
  filter(residue %in% c("S", "T", "Y")) %>%
  distinct(Substrate_Uniprot_ID, Site, residue, curated_site, ochoa_high, functional_score) %>%
  group_by(residue) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    n_sites      = n_distinct(paste(Substrate_Uniprot_ID, Site)),
    pct_pass     = 100 * mean(curated_site | ochoa_high, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_func_only = 100 * mean(ochoa_high[!is.na(functional_score)], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Classify by Entrez ID, exactly as Figure 3B does: gene symbols are not a stable
# key here (DarkKinaseTools still uses superseded symbols for a few genes).
kin_class_final <- all_kinases %>%
  transmute(Kinase_entrez = as.character(entrez_id),
            Kinase_class = if_else(class_2019 == "Dark", "Dark", "Light"))
kinase_entrez_lookup <- combined_pairs %>%
  distinct(Kinase, Kinase_entrez) %>%
  mutate(Kinase_entrez = as.character(Kinase_entrez))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(kinase_entrez_lookup$Kinase))   # one Entrez ID per symbol
dark_frac <- function(pairs) {
  d <- pairs %>%
    left_join(kinase_entrez_lookup, by = "Kinase") %>%
    inner_join(kin_class_final, by = "Kinase_entrez")
  100 * mean(d$Kinase_class == "Dark")
}

# The dark-kinase share is computed in two places (Figure 3B and the manuscript
# numbers). They must agree; a mismatch means a join key has drifted.
stopifnot(abs(100 * dark_fracs$frac_dark[dark_fracs$Set == "Curated + Specificity"] -
                dark_frac(distinct(bind_rows(pairs_curated, pairs_atlas)))) < 0.05)

manuscript_numbers <- tibble::tribble(
  ~quantity, ~value,
  "motif_percentile_cutoff",        as.character(motif_percentile_cutoff),
  "functional_score_cutoff",        as.character(functional_score_cutoff),
  "atlas_kinase_names_resolved",    as.character(nrow(atlas_kinase_map)),
  "atlas_kinase_genes",             as.character(n_distinct(atlas_kinase_map$Kinase)),
  "kinases_total",                  as.character(n_distinct(combined_pairs$Kinase)),
  "substrates_total",               as.character(n_distinct(combined_pairs$Substrate)),
  "phosphosites_total",             as.character(nrow(distinct(combined_pairs, Substrate, Site))),
  "pairs_curated",                  as.character(nrow(pairs_curated)),
  "pairs_atlas",                    as.character(nrow(pairs_atlas)),
  "pairs_novel",                    as.character(nrow(pairs_novel)),
  "pairs_total",                    as.character(nrow(distinct(bind_rows(pairs_curated, pairs_atlas)))),
  "pct_increase_over_curated",      sprintf("%.1f", 100 * nrow(pairs_novel) / nrow(pairs_curated)),
  "median_novel_substrates_per_kinase", as.character(median(novel_per_kinase$n_novel)),
  "max_novel_substrates_per_kinase",    as.character(max(novel_per_kinase$n_novel)),
  # Median over kinases of the fraction of a kinase's predicted substrates that share
  # a compartment with it. This is the quantity plotted in Figure 2A and it is the
  # fraction the co-localization filter retains: substrates with no HPA annotation
  # count as non-co-localized, exactly as in the filter itself.
  "median_pct_coloc_per_kinase", sprintf("%.1f", median(per_kinase_coloc$pct_coloc_all, na.rm = TRUE)),
  "pct_pass_S",                     sprintf("%.1f", residue_pass$pct_pass[residue_pass$residue == "S"]),
  "pct_pass_T",                     sprintf("%.1f", residue_pass$pct_pass[residue_pass$residue == "T"]),
  "pct_pass_Y",                     sprintf("%.1f", residue_pass$pct_pass[residue_pass$residue == "Y"]),
  "pct_func_only_S",                sprintf("%.1f", residue_pass$pct_func_only[residue_pass$residue == "S"]),
  "pct_func_only_T",                sprintf("%.1f", residue_pass$pct_func_only[residue_pass$residue == "T"]),
  "pct_func_only_Y",                sprintf("%.1f", residue_pass$pct_func_only[residue_pass$residue == "Y"]),
  "n_sites_S",                      as.character(residue_pass$n_sites[residue_pass$residue == "S"]),
  "n_sites_T",                      as.character(residue_pass$n_sites[residue_pass$residue == "T"]),
  "n_sites_Y",                      as.character(residue_pass$n_sites[residue_pass$residue == "Y"]),
  "dark_pct_curated",               sprintf("%.1f", dark_frac(pairs_curated)),
  "dark_pct_integrated",            sprintf("%.1f", dark_frac(distinct(bind_rows(pairs_curated, pairs_atlas))))
)

# chi-square test for the residue-class difference the manuscript reports
residue_tab <- cantley_sites90 %>%
  mutate(residue = substr(Site, 1, 1)) %>%
  filter(residue %in% c("S", "T", "Y")) %>%
  distinct(Substrate_Uniprot_ID, Site, residue, curated_site, ochoa_high) %>%
  mutate(pass = curated_site | ochoa_high) %>%
  count(residue, pass) %>%
  rename(ochoa_high = pass) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ochoa_high, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("residue") %>%
  as.matrix()
residue_chisq <- chisq.test(residue_tab)
manuscript_numbers <- bind_rows(manuscript_numbers, tibble::tibble(
  quantity = c("residue_chisq_statistic", "residue_chisq_df", "residue_chisq_p"),
  value = c(sprintf("%.1f", unname(residue_chisq$statistic)),
            as.character(unname(residue_chisq$parameter)),
            format.pval(residue_chisq$p.value, digits = 3))
))

write_csv(manuscript_numbers, here("results/manuscript_numbers.csv"))
print(as.data.frame(manuscript_numbers), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Supplemental datasets

```{r}
# Supplementary Table S1: the complete unfiltered specificity-atlas prediction
# matrix, retaining continuous percentile, rank and promiscuity values.
write_csv(cantley_feats, here("results/unfiltered_cantley_dataset.csv"))

# Supplementary Table S2: gene-level HPA subcellular compartment assignments.
write_csv(subcellular_localization, here("results/subcellular_localization_mapping.csv"))

# Supplementary Table S3: Ochoa et al. phosphosite functional scores mapped onto
# our site identifiers.
write_csv(ochoa_fs_processed, here("results/ochoa_functional_scores.csv"))

# Relaxed motif tier: same contextual criteria, motif percentile lowered to
# `relaxed_percentile_cutoff`. Released separately and explicitly labelled so it
# cannot be mistaken for the high-confidence set.
relaxed_candidates <- cantley_feats %>%
  filter(!is.na(Percentile),
         Percentile >= relaxed_percentile_cutoff,
         Percentile <  motif_percentile_cutoff,
         promiscuity_index < promiscuity_index_cutoff,
         !is.na(Kinase), !is.na(Substrate)) %>%
  mutate(position = as.integer(position)) %>%
  left_join(ochoa_fs_norm, by = c("Substrate_Uniprot_ID", "position")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(functional_score), functional_score >= functional_score_cutoff)

# Co-localization is recomputed for this tier rather than reused: the top-tier
# counts were restricted to genes appearing in the stringent set, so reusing them
# would silently mark most relaxed-tier pairs as non-co-localized.
relaxed_genes <- unique(c(relaxed_candidates$Kinase_entrez,
                          relaxed_candidates$Substrate_entrez))
relaxed_hpa <- hpa_long %>% filter(Gene_entrez %in% relaxed_genes)
relaxed_coloc <- inner_join(
    relaxed_hpa %>% transmute(locs, Kinase_entrez = Gene_entrez) %>% distinct(),
    relaxed_hpa %>% transmute(locs, Substrate_entrez = Gene_entrez) %>% distinct(),
    by = "locs", relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  count(Kinase_entrez, Substrate_entrez, name = "n_shared_compartments")

relaxed_tier <- relaxed_candidates %>%
  left_join(relaxed_coloc, by = c("Kinase_entrez", "Substrate_entrez")) %>%
  mutate(n_shared_compartments = coalesce(n_shared_compartments, 0L)) %>%
  filter(n_shared_compartments > 0L) %>%
  transmute(Kinase, Kinase_entrez, Substrate, Substrate_entrez,
            Substrate_Uniprot_ID, Site,
            Motif_percentile = Percentile, Motif_rank = Rank,
            Promiscuity_index = promiscuity_index,
            Functional_score = functional_score,
            Shared_compartments = n_shared_compartments,
            Tier = paste0("Relaxed (motif percentile ", relaxed_percentile_cutoff, "-",
                          motif_percentile_cutoff, ")")) %>%
  distinct()

write_csv(relaxed_tier, here("results/relaxed_tier_kinase_substrate_pairs.csv"))
message("Relaxed tier: ", nrow(relaxed_tier), " kinase-substrate-site rows across ",
        dplyr::n_distinct(paste(relaxed_tier$Kinase, relaxed_tier$Substrate)), " pairs.")
```

## Add in substrate-substrate interactions from HIPPIE

```{r, eval=FALSE}
## Adding in HIPPIE data for inter-substrate PPIs
#
# NOTE: this section is not part of the KinaseCanvas resource described in the
# manuscript; it builds a substrate-substrate PPI extension used by a separate
# downstream project. It is disabled because the HIPPIE file currently in
# `data/` is the native six-column HIPPIE export, not the MITAB release whose
# column names this code parses. Re-enable it only alongside a matching file.
# Read in Hippie data for PPIs
hippie <- read_tsv(here("data/hippie_current.txt"))

hippie  %>% 
  names()

hippie  %>% 
  head()  %>% 
  view()  

#Values in INteraction type and INteraction Identifer columns 
types = hippie$`Interaction Detection Methods`  %>% unique()


# Filter to only physical interactions between substrates

substrate_IDs <- unique(combined_pairs$Substrate_entrez)
kinase_IDs    <- unique(combined_pairs$Kinase_entrez)

substrate_IDs <- setdiff(substrate_IDs, kinase_IDs)
combined_IDs  <- union(substrate_IDs, kinase_IDs)

# --- HIPPIE → substrate-substrate + kinase autophosphorylation only ---
hippie_processed <- hippie %>% 
  select(
    Protein1_entrez = `ID Interactor A`,
    Protein2_entrez = `ID Interactor B`,
    confidence_score = `Confidence Value`,
    Interaction_detection_method = `Interaction Detection Methods`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Protein1_entrez = str_replace(Protein1_entrez, "^entrez gene:", ""),
    Protein2_entrez = str_replace(Protein2_entrez, "^entrez gene:", "")
  ) %>%
  # Node filter 
  filter(Protein1_entrez %in% combined_IDs,
         Protein2_entrez %in% combined_IDs) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # classify edge type
  mutate(
    is_sub1 = Protein1_entrez %in% substrate_IDs,
    is_sub2 = Protein2_entrez %in% substrate_IDs,
    EdgeType = if_else(
      is_sub1 & is_sub2, "substrate-substrate", "exclude"
    )
  ) %>%
  # drop everything else:
  #  - kinase–substrate (is_kinX & is_subY)
  #  - kinase–kinase (kinases)
  #  - self-loops (if present in HIPPIE; rare but possible)
  #  - substrate autoloops (if present in HIPPIE; usually rare/artefactual)
  filter(EdgeType != "exclude") %>%
  select(Protein1_entrez, Protein2_entrez, confidence_score,
         Interaction_detection_method, EdgeType) %>%
  distinct()

hippie_processed  %>% head()  %>% view()

# #quick look at confidence score distribution
# ggplot(hippie_processed, aes(confidence_score)) +
#   geom_histogram(bins=100, fill="grey70", color="black") +
#   #lines for quantiles
#   geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(hippie_processed$confidence_score, probs=c(0.75, 0.9)), linetype="dashed", color="red") +
#   labs(x="Confidence score", y="Count") +
#   scale_y_continuous(labels=comma, expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.1))) +  # 10% headroom
#   theme_pubr()

confidence_cutoff = quantile(hippie_processed$confidence_score, probs=0.75)

# #quick look at MI codes in Interaction Detection Methods column (need to split by "|")
# #also show Ns in the dataset
# hippie %>%
#   filter(`Confidence Value` > confidence_cutoff) %>%
#   select(`Interaction Detection Methods`) %>%
#   separate_rows(`Interaction Detection Methods`, sep="\\|") %>%
#   group_by(`Interaction Detection Methods`)  %>%
#   summarise(N = n())  %>%
#   arrange(desc(N))  %>%
#   ungroup()  %>%
#   mutate(`Interaction Detection Methods` = str_replace_all(`Interaction Detection Methods`, "MI:", ""))  %>%
#   arrange(desc(N))  %>%
#   view()
# ## Assays to filter out: 
# 0428(imaging technique)
# 0493(in vivo)
# 0492(in vitro)

hippie_symbol_to_entrez_1 = bitr(hippie_processed$Protein1_entrez, fromType="ENTREZID", toType=c("SYMBOL"), OrgDb="org.Hs.eg.db")  %>%
  rename(Protein1_entrez = ENTREZID, Protein1 = SYMBOL)  %>%
  distinct()

hippie_symbol_to_entrez_2 = bitr(hippie_processed$Protein2_entrez, fromType="ENTREZID", toType=c("SYMBOL"), OrgDb="org.Hs.eg.db")  %>%
  rename(Protein2_entrez = ENTREZID, Protein2 = SYMBOL)  %>%
  distinct()

hippie_entrez = hippie_processed  %>%
  left_join(hippie_symbol_to_entrez_1, by="Protein1_entrez")  %>%
  left_join(hippie_symbol_to_entrez_2, by="Protein2_entrez")  %>%
  drop_na(Protein1, Protein2)  %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # Consulted with proteomics colleagues, decided to filter out certain methods
  filter(Interaction_detection_method != "MI:0428")  %>% #remove imaging technique (too vague)
  filter(Interaction_detection_method != "MI:0493")  %>% #remove in vivo (too vague)
  filter(Interaction_detection_method != "MI:0492")  %>% #remove in vitro (too vague)
  filter(Protein1_entrez != Protein2_entrez)  %>% #remove self-loops
  filter(confidence_score > confidence_cutoff)  %>%
  select(Protein1, Protein2, Protein1_entrez, Protein2_entrez, Evidence = Interaction_detection_method)  %>%
  mutate(Source = "HIPPIE")  %>%
  distinct()


# Combine with integrated data
full_interaction_data = combined_pairs  %>%
  select(
    Protein1 = Kinase,
    Protein2 = Substrate,
    Protein1_entrez = Kinase_entrez,
    Protein2_entrez = Substrate_entrez,
    Evidence,
    Source
  )  %>%
  mutate(Protein1_entrez = as.character(Protein1_entrez),
         Protein2_entrez = as.character(Protein2_entrez))  %>% 
  bind_rows(hippie_entrez)  %>%
  distinct() %>%
  write_csv(here("results/extended_kinome_network.csv"))

#summarise across sources
full_interaction_summary = full_interaction_data  %>%
  group_by(Protein1, Protein2, Protein1_entrez, Protein2_entrez)  %>%
  summarise(
    n_sources = n_distinct(Source),
    Sources   = paste(sort(unique(Source)), collapse="; "),
    Evidence  = paste(sort(unique(Evidence)), collapse="; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  write_csv(here("results/extended_kinome_network_summary.csv"))

```
